units.source_text: 这个村落使人意外的，其实远不止它的宽大。

en.t: What was surprising about this village was in fact far more than just its size.

units.source_text: 奇怪的是那条道路，竟会渐渐上坡而去。

en.t: What was strange was that the road gradually climbed upward.

units.source_text: 这与他的预想完全相背。

en.t: This was completely contrary to what he had expected.

units.source_text: 既然面临大海，那路该是下坡道才对呵。

en.t: Since it faced the sea, the road ought to have been sloping downward.

units.source_text: 正好有个年轻姑娘走过来，他赶忙向姑娘打听。

en.t: Just then a young woman came walking by, and he hurriedly asked her for directions.

units.source_text: 谁知那姑娘慌慌张张地避开他的目光，像没听见似的，赶快跑了。

en.t: But the young woman flusteredly avoided his eyes and quickly ran off as if she had not heard him.

units.source_text: 不得已，他决定不管三七二十一，再往前走一段试试。

en.t: Having no choice, he decided to press on a little farther and see what happened.

units.source_text: 至少光凭沙的颜色，鱼网，还有贝壳山等等，就能确定附近肯定有海滩。

en.t: At the very least, from the color of the sand, the fishing nets, the piles of shells, and so on, he could be sure there was a beach nearby.

units.source_text: 事实上，那里还没有任何能预示危险的东西。

en.t: In fact, there was still nothing there to suggest any danger.
